70e6aaa207a65eed4b4833d0696a7d4e130bda33.summary: Lookout describes KoSpy, an Android spyware family disguised as utility apps and distributed through Google Play and Firebase Firestore, aimed at Korean and English-speaking users. Lookout attributes it to the North Korean group ScarCruft (APT37) with medium confidence and notes ties to APT43 infrastructure. Samples date from March 2022 to March 2024. The apps were removed from Google Play and the Firebase projects deactivated.

70c8c187f3ec6aef60cd3daebad232a3290fbfbf.summary: Huntress analysis of a macOS variant of the LightSpy spyware framework, uploaded to VirusTotal and described by BlackBerry as an iOS implant. The sample is x86_64 and runs on Intel Macs or Apple Silicon with Rosetta 2. It uses a dropper, a core implant and 10 plugins for files, keychain, browser history, camera, screen and Wi-Fi data. Prior research links LightSpy to APT 41, but the post makes no attribution claim itself. YARA and Sigma rules are provided.
